description: Midterm structure effect s_cp per county x party group: logit-scale turnout relative to the statewide party level in a midterm general.
checks_passed: covariates.csv has one row per county
(1 | county) variance is ~0 in simplification 1, so dropping it leaves the fit unchanged
final fit has the same likelihood as simplification 1 (one fewer parameter)
GG18 and GG22 fitted ballots sum by party to within 0.1% of observed
invlogit(alpha_hat + s_hat + u_obs) reproduces fitted rates in every midterm cell
midterm fitted rates within 1 point of observed in every cell
draw means of s_cp within 0.02 of the point estimates
15 election x party levels (no OTH in primaries)
bootMer statistic matches the point estimate on the fit
backtest GG22 calibrated totals match actual statewide ballots
backtest GG18 calibrated totals match actual statewide ballots
notes: Model: cbind(ballots_cast, active - ballots_cast) ~ 0 + ep + z_share_ba_plus + z_median_age + z_share_moved_past_year + z_share_owner_occupied + (1 | county:party_group) + (1 | county:election_type) + (1 | obs) (binomial glmer, bobyqa). s_cp = covariate part + u_county:party_group + u_county:election_type at midterm_general; (1 | county) is dropped (variance estimated at exactly 0), so it contributes nothing. See fit_summary.json.

columns.s_mean: point estimate (fixed effects and conditional modes)
